issue_context.title: Oral-B Integration recognising io9 as io8
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Oral-B integration seems to be missing the io9 dataprint. It's being recognised as an io8.
I have included the advertisement broadcast for your information.

Also, there is a mode called "Tongue Clean" that shows up as "unknown mode 6" if you would like to include that for the io9.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.11.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Oral-B

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/oralb

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?


I added support for Tongue Cleaning in my [MR yesterday](https://github.com/Bluetooth-Devices/oralb-ble/pull/29)

And today I have made a MR that slightly fixes the misidentification problem. IO8 and IO9 can have identical device bytes and cause identification issues. I have a potential fix, but I unfortunately can't be sure about it until I see more IO8 manufacturer data, which I do not have (I was only able to find one instance).

So for the moment, IO 8 and IO 9 are grouped together and will identify as Oral-B IO Series 8/9.

This change has been made in the base package that the integration relies on, but it will not update on your side until I make a PR for home assistant and my changes get folded in.

Well that's just not fair is it? Fancy using the same device bytes!
I think the combination is a good idea, considering the vast similarities between the two. Happy with that idea.
I appreciate you looking into it and working on it. If you need any data from my IO9, please let me know and I'll be happy to provide where I can.

Many Thanks.
